messages.subject: Re: [R-sig-DB] How to write to database schema other than public using RPostgreSQL
messages.subject_clean: How to write to database schema other than public using RPostgreSQL
messages.body_plain:
Your mileage may vary, but I found that 

rs <- dbGetQuery(crsp,"SET search_path TO temp")

worked well on Mac OS X. Thereafter, dbWriteTable would put the table in the 
"temp" schema. But this caused problems under Ubuntu with "overwrite=TRUE". 
Not sure why (in each case, the database is running under PostgreSQL 9.0 on 
my Mac, though I only have PostgreSQL 8.4 on the Ubuntu side).
